svg.title: CodeGraph paths and materialization boundaries
svg.desc: Existing analyzer output from SCIP (index.decoded) and clangd (idx shards) is adapted into provider facts, the shared contract: definitions and references, occurrences and ranges, adjacency and order, roles and diagnostics, as paths, ranges and roles. Three paths sit behind it. The native query path is FactQueryIndex with an adapter: integer postings, provider-gated capabilities, symbols, optional positions and a route adapter, format v3, no graphs. The provider-neutral model is FactBatch v1 in one file: validated per-file facts with no database lifecycle, with source digest, profile digest and provenance in a native buffer. The compatibility authority is the complete CodeGraph on igraph, by direct selection or request fallback. Identity failures fail closed, and external analyzer generation is excluded.
svg.text: Provider-specific representations stay behind explicit capability and identity gates.
